article_content: 'KABUL, Afghanistan (CNN) -- Hundreds of music fans eagerly awaited their favorite singers on the hit television show, 'Afghan Star'. Elaha Sorur was the only female finalist this season.  Just a few years prior, television and certain types of music were banned. Fans braved security measures in Kabul to attend the 'Afghan Star' finals, Afghanistan's version of 'American Idol'.  Modern outfits contrasted with Kabul's typically conservative dress code.  Onstage, contemporary styles were showcased, reflecting the nation's evolving cultural landscape. 'It's important for the young generation to be cool, with a cool mind,' one fan remarked. Inside, Jahid Mohseni, a media mogul, managed the bustling scene.  Mohseni, founder of Tolo TV, aimed to revitalize Afghan culture after the Taliban era's restrictions on music and television. 'We are promoting social change, but we cannot force Afghan society. This reflects what people want,' Mohseni stated.  Over 60% of Afghanistan's population is under 25, and the show's popularity suggests their desires resonate with global trends. The audience at the fourth-season finals included enthusiastic supporters of contestants like eventual winner Naweed Forugh, Naweed Sabirpur, Mehran Gulzar, and Elaha Sorur. 'Art is in the blood of Afghans...With time, it will get better,' Sorur commented. Not all approved of Mohseni's programming. The Ulema Council criticized 'Afghan Star' and Tolo TV's Indian soap operas as culturally inappropriate. The information and culture minister even tried to ban the soap operas. Mohseni argued that Afghanistan is influenced by its larger neighbors, India and Iran.  'If we don't have Afghan music and entertainment, Bollywood will take over,' he explained.  Tolo TV also broadcasts 'Tartil' ('Koran Star'), a Quran recitation competition. The winner, Uzra Mohamedi, a 16-year-old schoolgirl, accepted her prize modestly. Other programming includes news, lifestyle shows, a family drama, a comedy show, and the American series '24'. Mohseni believes 'Afghan Star' subtly promotes democracy through audience voting.  He noted that losing contestants now graciously accept defeat.  'This is the educational component...hopefully it'll rub off on our politicians,' he said.  For the August presidential elections, Mohseni created 'The Candidate' to encourage political debate. Mohseni hopes Afghanistan's cultural direction will be decided democratically.  Both 'Afghan Star' and 'Koran Star' were highly successful, according to Mohseni.'
translated_content: 'KABUL, Afghanistan (CNN) -- Beratus-ratus peminat muzik teruja menantikan penyanyi kegemaran mereka dalam rancangan televisyen popular, 'Afghan Star'. Elaha Sorur adalah satu-satunya finalis wanita musim ini. Hanya beberapa tahun sebelumnya, televisyen dan sesetengah jenis muzik diharamkan.  Peminat sanggup berhadapan dengan kawalan keselamatan yang ketat di Kabul untuk menghadiri pusingan akhir 'Afghan Star', versi Afghanistan bagi 'American Idol'. Pakaian moden berbeza dengan kod pakaian yang lazimnya konservatif di Kabul. Di atas pentas, gaya kontemporari dipamerkan, mencerminkan landskap budaya negara yang sedang berkembang.  'Penting untuk generasi muda menjadi 'cool', dengan pemikiran yang 'cool',' ujar seorang peminat.  Di dalam dewan konsert, Jahid Mohseni, seorang tokoh media, menguruskan suasana yang sibuk. Mohseni, pengasas Tolo TV,  bertujuan untuk menghidupkan semula budaya Afghanistan selepas sekatan era Taliban terhadap muzik dan televisyen.  'Kami sedang mempromosikan perubahan sosial, tetapi kami tidak boleh memaksa masyarakat Afghanistan. Rancangan ini mencerminkan apa yang orang mahukan,' kata Mohseni. Lebih 60% penduduk Afghanistan berusia di bawah 25 tahun, dan populariti rancangan ini menunjukkan bahawa keinginan mereka selari dengan trend global.  Para penonton di pusingan akhir musim keempat termasuklah penyokong-penyokong tegar para peserta seperti bakal pemenang Naweed Forugh, Naweed Sabirpur, Mehran Gulzar, dan Elaha Sorur.  'Seni mengalir dalam darah orang Afghanistan…Lama-kelamaan, ia akan menjadi lebih baik,' komen Sorur.  Tidak semua pihak bersetuju dengan rancangan Mohseni. Majlis Ulama mengkritik 'Afghan Star' dan drama bersiri India terbitan Tolo TV kerana dianggap tidak sesuai dengan budaya tempatan.  Menteri Penerangan dan Kebudayaan malah cuba mengharamkan drama-drama tersebut. Mohseni berhujah bahawa Afghanistan dipengaruhi oleh jirannya yang lebih besar, India dan Iran. 'Jika kita tidak mempunyai muzik dan hiburan Afghanistan sendiri, Bollywood akan menguasai,' jelasnya.  Tolo TV juga menyiarkan 'Tartil' ('Koran Star'), sebuah pertandingan bacaan al-Quran. Pemenangnya, Uzra Mohamedi, seorang pelajar perempuan berusia 16 tahun, menerima hadiahnya dengan penuh rendah diri.  Rancangan-rancangan lain yang disiarkan termasuklah berita, rancangan gaya hidup, drama kekeluargaan terbitan tempatan, rancangan komedi, dan siri Amerika '24'. Mohseni percaya bahawa 'Afghan Star' secara tidak langsung mempromosikan demokrasi melalui undian penonton.  Beliau menyatakan bahawa peserta yang kalah kini menerima kekalahan mereka dengan baik. 'Ini adalah komponen pendidikan…diharap ia akan menjadi contoh kepada ahli-ahli politik kita,' katanya. Sempena pilihan raya presiden pada bulan Ogos, Mohseni telah mencipta rancangan realiti bertajuk 'The Candidate' untuk menggalakkan perdebatan politik.  Mohseni berharap hala tuju budaya Afghanistan akan diputuskan secara demokratik. Kedua-dua rancangan  'Afghan Star' dan 'Koran Star' berjaya meraih rating yang tinggi, menurut Mohseni.'

article_content: 'In Texas, a state known for its gun-friendly laws, a concerning trend has emerged: more senior citizens are facing legal trouble for carrying firearms in their hand luggage at airports.  Recent data from Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport reveals an increase in such arrests, particularly among those in their 60s and 70s.  During July and August, almost half of the eleven individuals apprehended for carrying firearms in their carry-on luggage were senior citizens.  According to WFAA, an ABC affiliate, all five of these seniors claimed to have forgotten the firearms were in their bags. While charges were ultimately dropped, the incidents raise concerns. This uptick in arrests may correlate with the growing number of older Texans obtaining gun permits.  State data indicates that 67,000 permits were issued to individuals aged 60 to 100 last year, including a notable rise in permits for those in their 90s. David Prince, who owns Eagle Gun Range near Dallas, observes an increase in seniors seeking firearms training for personal protection. He suggests that airport security checks, often conducted in busy and distracting environments, might contribute to seniors forgetting they are carrying firearms.  Prince, himself 65, acknowledges age-related forgetfulness as a potential factor.'
translated_content: 'Di Texas, sebuah negeri yang dikenali dengan undang-undang mesra senjata, satu trend yang membimbangkan telah muncul: lebih ramai warga emas menghadapi masalah undang-undang kerana membawa senjata api dalam bagasi tangan mereka di lapangan terbang. Data terkini dari Lapangan Terbang Antarabangsa Dallas/Fort Worth mendedahkan peningkatan dalam tangkapan sedemikian, terutamanya dalam kalangan mereka yang berusia 60-an dan 70-an. Sepanjang Julai dan Ogos, hampir separuh daripada sebelas individu yang ditahan kerana membawa senjata api dalam bagasi kabin mereka adalah warga emas. Menurut WFAA, sebuah sekutu ABC, kesemua lima warga emas ini mendakwa terlupa bahawa senjata api itu berada dalam beg mereka. Walaupun pertuduhan akhirnya digugurkan, insiden itu menimbulkan kebimbangan. Peningkatan tangkapan ini mungkin berkaitan dengan peningkatan bilangan warga emas Texas yang mendapatkan permit senjata api. Data negeri menunjukkan bahawa 67,000 permit dikeluarkan kepada individu berumur 60 hingga 100 tahun lepas, termasuk peningkatan ketara dalam permit untuk mereka yang berusia 90-an. David Prince, yang memiliki Eagle Gun Range berhampiran Dallas, memerhatikan peningkatan warga emas yang mencari latihan senjata api untuk perlindungan diri. Beliau mencadangkan bahawa pemeriksaan keselamatan lapangan terbang, yang sering dijalankan dalam persekitaran yang sibuk dan mengganggu, mungkin menyumbang kepada warga emas terlupa bahawa mereka membawa senjata api. Prince, yang berusia 65 tahun, mengakui bahawa mudah lupa yang berkaitan dengan usia sebagai faktor yang berpotensi.'

article_content: New York police released surveillance video on January 3, 2012, showing a man wanted for firebombing an Islamic center and a Hindu place of worship on New Year's Day. The video shows the suspect throwing a Molotov cocktail at a Queens residence that also houses a Hindu temple.  A $12,000 reward is offered for information leading to the arrest and conviction of the suspect, described as a Black male, 25-30 years old, approximately 5'8" and 200 lbs. He wore a black jacket and baseball cap and fled in a light-colored, four-door sedan.  The suspect is linked to similar attacks at the Al-Khoei Benevolent Foundation Islamic center, a deli on 179th Street, and a home at 146-62 107th Avenue. The video was taken at 88-20 170th Street. The incidents occurred between 8 and 10:15 p.m. on Sunday within a two-mile radius.  While no one was injured, the house on 107th Avenue suffered significant fire damage.  Around 80 worshippers were inside the Al-Khoei Benevolent Foundation, which also houses a Shiite mosque, when a bottle was thrown at the building. The device caused minor damage. Governor Andrew Cuomo condemned the attacks.  This incident follows recent controversy over NYPD surveillance programs targeting Muslim communities, which led some Muslim leaders to boycott the mayor's interfaith breakfast.

Video tersebut menunjukkan suspek melemparkan bom Molotov ke arah sebuah kediaman di Queens yang juga menempatkan sebuah kuil Hindu. Ganjaran $12,000 ditawarkan bagi maklumat yang membawa kepada penangkapan dan sabitan suspek, digambarkan sebagai lelaki berkulit hitam, 25-30 tahun, kira-kira 5'8" tinggi dan 200 paun. Dia memakai jaket hitam dan topi besbol serta melarikan diri dengan kereta sedan empat pintu berwarna cerah. Suspek dikaitkan dengan serangan serupa di pusat Islam Yayasan Kebajikan Al-Khoei, sebuah kedai makan di Jalan ke-179, dan sebuah rumah di 146-62 Lorong ke-107. Video itu dirakam di 88-20 Jalan ke-170. Insiden-insiden tersebut berlaku antara 8 dan 10:15 malam Ahad dalam radius dua batu. Walaupun tiada kecederaan, rumah di Lorong ke-107 mengalami kerosakan teruk akibat kebakaran. Kira-kira 80 jemaah berada di dalam Yayasan Kebajikan Al-Khoei, yang turut menempatkan sebuah masjid Syiah, ketika sebotol dilemparkan ke bangunan tersebut. Peranti itu menyebabkan kerosakan kecil. Gabenor Andrew Cuomo mengutuk serangan tersebut. Insiden ini menyusuli kontroversi baru-baru ini berhubung program pengawasan NYPD yang menyasarkan komuniti Islam, menyebabkan beberapa pemimpin Islam memboikot sarapan antara agama Datuk Bandar.

article_content: 'Asghar Farhadi's 'A Separation' is a remarkable film deserving of all its accolades, including the Golden Bear at the 2011 Berlin International Film Festival. It's a strong contender for Best Foreign Language Film at the Academy Awards. The story revolves around Nader and Simin, a married Iranian couple navigating a difficult time. Simin wishes to leave Iran with their daughter, Termeh, but Nader feels obligated to stay and care for his father who has Alzheimer's. Their disagreement leads to Simin filing for divorce, further complicating matters as she can't leave the country with Termeh without Nader's consent.  Nader refuses, so Simin moves in with her parents. The film beautifully intertwines family drama, mystery, and social commentary on modern Iran. While relatable on a universal level, it remains distinctly Iranian in its portrayal of cultural nuances.  Nader hires Razieh, a deeply religious woman, to care for his father, creating a clash of cultures and beliefs.  Razieh faces moral dilemmas related to her faith, even consulting her spiritual advisor. She suggests her husband, Hodjat, for the job, but his arrest for debt forces her return. Razieh's behavior hints at a secret, and an incident with Nader's father escalates the tension. The ensuing mystery adds another layer to the story, questioning who is responsible and why. Exploring Iranian social, religious, and political customs unveils answers and deepens the emotional impact.  The film's performances are exceptional, conveying emotions even without understanding the dialogue.  Farhadi's direction and the screenplay, especially the final ten minutes, are masterful, contributing to the film's overall brilliance.'
translated_content: 'Filem 'A Separation' arahan Asghar Farhadi merupakan sebuah filem yang luar biasa dan layak menerima segala pujian, termasuk anugerah Golden Bear di Festival Filem Antarabangsa Berlin 2011. Ia merupakan calon kuat untuk Filem Bahasa Asing Terbaik di Anugerah Akademi.  Kisahnya berkisarkan Nader dan Simin, pasangan suami isteri Iran yang sedang menghadapi masa sukar. Simin ingin meninggalkan Iran bersama anak perempuan mereka, Termeh, tetapi Nader merasa bertanggungjawab untuk tinggal dan menjaga bapanya yang menghidap Alzheimer. Perselisihan mereka menyebabkan Simin memfailkan perceraian, seterusnya merumitkan keadaan kerana dia tidak boleh meninggalkan negara ini bersama Termeh tanpa persetujuan Nader. Nader menolak, jadi Simin berpindah ke rumah ibu bapanya. Filem ini menggabungkan drama keluarga, misteri, dan ulasan sosial mengenai Iran moden dengan indah. Walaupun mudah difahami di peringkat universal, ia tetap mengekalkan ciri-ciri ke-Iranannya dalam menggambarkan nuansa budaya.  Nader mengupah Razieh, seorang wanita yang sangat warak, untuk menjaga bapanya, mewujudkan pertembungan budaya dan kepercayaan. Razieh menghadapi dilema moral berkaitan dengan kepercayaannya, malah berunding dengan penasihat rohaninya. Dia mencadangkan suaminya, Hodjat, untuk kerja itu, tetapi penahanan Hodjat kerana hutang memaksanya kembali. Tingkah laku Razieh membayangkan rahsia, dan satu kejadian dengan bapa Nader meningkatkan ketegangan. Misteri yang berlaku menambah lapisan lain pada cerita, mempersoalkan siapa yang bertanggungjawab dan mengapa. Meneroka adat istiadat sosial, agama, dan politik Iran mendedahkan jawapan dan memperdalam kesan emosi. Persembahan filem ini luar biasa, menyampaikan emosi walaupun tanpa memahami dialog. Arahan Farhadi dan lakon layar, terutamanya sepuluh minit terakhir, sangat mengagumkan, menyumbang kepada kecemerlangan keseluruhan filem.'

article_content: 'After her marriage failed, Lucienne Mainey developed a crippling online bingo addiction.  This addiction led her to embezzle over £76,000 from her employer, APD Ltd, a company based in Newmarket, Suffolk where she'd worked for 20 years. Initially, a seemingly minor £800 discrepancy was discovered and repaid.  However, the problem escalated, with Mainey caught playing bingo at work and subsequently found to have stolen a further £3,000. A thorough audit then unveiled the full extent of the fraud, totaling approximately £76,081, although the true losses, factoring in reclaimed VAT, were closer to £87,000. The case was heard at Ipswich Crown Court, where Mainey, from Duxford, Cambridgeshire, pleaded guilty to five counts of fraud, with an additional 25 offences taken into consideration.  Judge Peter Fenn sentenced her to 16 months in prison, stressing that such breaches of trust carry serious consequences.  Mainey's defense highlighted her remorse and the difficult circumstances surrounding her divorce in 2007 which triggered her gambling problem.'
translated_content: 'Setelah perkahwinannya gagal, Lucienne Mainey telah terjebak dalam ketagihan bingo dalam talian yang serius. Ketagihan ini menyebabkan beliau menggelapkan lebih daripada £76,000 daripada majikannya, APD Ltd, sebuah syarikat yang berpangkalan di Newmarket, Suffolk di mana beliau telah bekerja selama 20 tahun. Pada mulanya, terdapat percanggahan kecil sebanyak £800 yang telah dikesan dan dibayar balik. Walau bagaimanapun, masalah tersebut semakin melarat, dengan Mainey ditangkap bermain bingo di tempat kerja dan kemudiannya didapati telah mencuri lagi £3,000. Audit menyeluruh kemudian mendedahkan jumlah penuh penipuan tersebut, berjumlah kira-kira £76,081, walaupun kerugian sebenar, termasuk VAT yang dituntut semula, adalah hampir £87,000. Kes itu dibicarakan di Mahkamah Ipswich Crown, di mana Mainey, dari Duxford, Cambridgeshire, mengaku bersalah atas lima pertuduhan penipuan, dengan tambahan 25 kesalahan yang diambil kira. Hakim Peter Fenn menjatuhkan hukuman penjara 16 bulan ke atasnya, dengan menekankan bahawa pelanggaran amanah sedemikian membawa akibat yang serius. Pembelaan Mainey mengetengahkan rasa kesalnya dan keadaan sukar sekitar perceraiannya pada tahun 2007 yang mencetuskan masalah perjudiannya.'

article_content: 'Istanbul, Turkey (CNN) – Turkish companies are facing difficulties following a Syrian government decision to ban imports of products with customs taxes exceeding 5%.  The Turkish government is contemplating retaliatory measures, including potential economic sanctions, against its neighbor.  On September 22, Syria announced the suspension of high-tariff goods imports, a move the Syrian Minister of Economy and Trade later called 'temporary and precautionary,' aimed at preserving foreign currency reserves.  Banned items include mobile phones, contact lens fluid, and various vehicles, according to the Turkish Ministry of Economy.  This ban threatens trade between the two countries, which had tripled between 2006 and 2010 following a free trade agreement. Turkish businesses are concerned.  'Companies are calling us asking about it…For example, a client selling car batteries is now unsure about proceeding,' said Ibrahim Eminoglu of the Antakya Chamber of Commerce. Murat Akyuz, chairman of the Mining and Metals Exporters' Association, stated they would seek alternative markets to offset losses.  Strained political relations, stemming from the Syrian uprising and subsequent crackdown, have further complicated the situation. Turkey has criticized Syria's actions and provided refuge for Syrian refugees.  A Turkish official confirmed that further steps against Syria are being considered.  Media speculation suggests potential economic sanctions, including freezing Syrian government assets. Some Turkish industrial leaders worry about access to Middle Eastern markets. 'Syria is a key transit route…We are exploring alternative routes, like shipping containers,' Eminoglu added.  The import ban appears unpopular within the Syrian business community.  Syrian journalist Sami Moubayed warned it could create a rift between the government and businesses, many of which are already struggling due to existing U.S. and European sanctions.'
translated_content: 'Istanbul, Turki (CNN) – Syarikat-syarikat Turki menghadapi kesukaran susulan keputusan kerajaan Syria untuk mengharamkan import produk dengan cukai kastam melebihi 5%. Kerajaan Turki sedang mempertimbangkan langkah balas, termasuk kemungkinan sekatan ekonomi, terhadap jirannya. Pada 22 September, Syria mengumumkan penggantungan import barangan bercukai tinggi, satu langkah yang kemudiannya disebut oleh Menteri Ekonomi dan Perdagangan Syria sebagai 'sementara dan berjaga-jaga,' bertujuan untuk memelihara rizab mata wang asing.  Barangan yang diharamkan termasuk telefon bimbit, cecair kanta lekap, dan pelbagai kenderaan, menurut Kementerian Ekonomi Turki. Larangan ini mengancam perdagangan antara kedua-dua negara, yang telah meningkat tiga kali ganda antara 2006 dan 2010 berikutan perjanjian perdagangan bebas. Peniaga Turki bimbang.  'Syarikat-syarikat menghubungi kami bertanya tentangnya… Contohnya, pelanggan yang menjual bateri kereta kini tidak pasti sama ada untuk meneruskan,' kata Ibrahim Eminoglu dari Dewan Perniagaan Antakya. Murat Akyuz, pengerusi Persatuan Pengeksport Perlombongan dan Logam, menyatakan mereka akan mencari pasaran alternatif untuk mengimbangi kerugian. Hubungan politik yang tegang, berpunca daripada pemberontakan Syria dan tindakan keras berikutnya, telah merumitkan lagi keadaan. Turki telah mengkritik tindakan Syria dan menyediakan perlindungan untuk pelarian Syria.  Seorang pegawai Turki mengesahkan bahawa langkah selanjutnya terhadap Syria sedang dipertimbangkan. Spekulasi media mencadangkan kemungkinan sekatan ekonomi, termasuk pembekuan aset kerajaan Syria.  Beberapa pemimpin industri Turki bimbang tentang akses ke pasaran Timur Tengah.  'Syria adalah laluan transit utama…Kami sedang meneroka laluan alternatif, seperti penghantaran kontena,' tambah Eminoglu. Larangan import nampaknya tidak popular dalam kalangan komuniti perniagaan Syria. Wartawan Syria Sami Moubayed memberi amaran bahawa ia boleh mewujudkan perpecahan antara kerajaan dan perniagaan, yang kebanyakannya telah bergelut disebabkan oleh sekatan AS dan Eropah yang sedia ada.'

article_content: 'At the Perez Art Museum Miami, a local artist, Maximo Caminero, intentionally broke a vase forming part of a display by the renowned Chinese artist and activist, Ai Weiwei. This act, which occurred on Sunday, resulted in Caminero's arrest and a charge of criminal mischief. Caminero maintains that his action was an impulsive protest against the perceived marginalization of local artists by Miami's art institutions. The damaged vase, reportedly valued at $1 million, was part of Weiwei's 'Colored Vases' installation, which features ancient urns painted over in vibrant hues. Photographs accompanying the display depict Weiwei dropping and shattering a similar vase, an act that Caminero interpreted as an invitation to participate in a performative protest. Caminero expressed remorse for damaging such a valuable piece, explaining that he mistook it for an ordinary clay pot and was unaware of its significance. He further stated that his intention was to highlight the lack of opportunities afforded to local artists in Miami's prominent art spaces. Caminero, who has been a working artist for 30 years, intends to address the incident further at a press conference. Weiwei, known for his politically charged art and activism, including the design of Beijing's Bird's Nest Olympic stadium, has often faced challenges from the Chinese government.'
translated_content: 'Di Muzium Seni Perez Miami, seorang artis tempatan, Maximo Caminero, sengaja memecahkan sebuah pasu yang merupakan sebahagian daripada pameran oleh artis dan aktivis terkenal China, Ai Weiwei. Tindakan ini, yang berlaku pada hari Ahad, mengakibatkan penangkapan Caminero dan pertuduhan jenayah khianat. Caminero menegaskan bahawa tindakannya adalah protes spontan terhadap apa yang dilihatnya sebagai peminggiran artis tempatan oleh institusi seni Miami. Pasu yang rosak, dilaporkan bernilai $1 juta, adalah sebahagian daripada pemasangan 'Pasu Berwarna' Weiwei, yang menampilkan tembikar purba yang dicat dengan warna-warna terang. Gambar-gambar yang mengiringi pameran tersebut menggambarkan Weiwei menjatuhkan dan memecahkan pasu yang serupa, satu tindakan yang ditafsirkan oleh Caminero sebagai ajakan untuk menyertai protes persembahan. Caminero melahirkan rasa kesal kerana merosakkan karya yang begitu berharga, menjelaskan bahawa dia menyangka ia pasu tanah liat biasa dan tidak menyedari kepentingannya. Dia selanjutnya menyatakan bahawa niatnya adalah untuk mengetengahkan kekurangan peluang yang diberikan kepada artis tempatan di ruang seni terkemuka Miami. Caminero, yang telah menjadi artis selama 30 tahun, berhasrat untuk menangani insiden itu dengan lebih lanjut pada sidang akhbar. Weiwei, yang terkenal dengan seni dan aktivisme politiknya, termasuk reka bentuk Stadium Olimpik Sarang Burung Beijing, sering menghadapi cabaran daripada kerajaan China.'
